title: Geoapify OpenAPI catalog
description: Machine-readable catalog of Geoapify OpenAPI specifications and their canonical documentation pages. Load only the specifications needed for an integration.

apis.title: Geoapify Batch API
apis.description:
Use the Batch API to process multiple requests in one job or run supported Geoapify tasks asynchronously.

- Submit 1 to 1000 inputs for the same supported API endpoint.
- Poll the returned batch job ID until processing is complete.
- Choose a processing priority between `0.5` and `1` to balance credit cost and processing speed.
